name: add-fstab-mounts
description: Install new-BP fstab (root + core_nhlos_a/dtb_a/persist mounts), mount /vendor from initramfs so firmware symlinks resolve before udev autoloads their drivers, and regenerate initramfs. No /boot/efi mount: UEFI reads the ESP directly, and an unmountable ESP must not fail local-fs.target into emergency mode.
